text_block_list.text:
This year's juniors are called the "Golden

Generation."
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: It's a mystery as to who coined the term.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, is it true? I hear they're all training
together
today.
text_block_list.name: Sharp-Eared Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
It seems like it. Hehe... I'm looking
forward to
seeing them.
text_block_list.name: Intelligent Репортёр

text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting, everyone!
They're here!
text_block_list.name: Intelligent Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. I'm so happy we can all make
our debut
together this year!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
It's Спешл Уик, an Umamusume
always at the
center of everyone's
attention. She's moved to
Tokyo from
the countryside to keep a promise
she
made to her mothers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. It's always a pleasure to
compete with
everyone. With that said,
shall we begin our run?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер comes from abroad, but
has the air
of a traditional Japanese
lady. She may appear
gentle, but deep
down, she has an iron will and
has been
catching attention ever since tryouts.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oye! What's going on here?! You're not
startin'
without me, are you?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Feast your eyes! The all powerful
Phantom Bird
has arrived! A race without
El is like a taco
without salsa!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
And here is Эль Кондор Паса. Her goal is
to
become the world's strongest, and
she has
captivated people since even
before her debut—a
natural-born
performer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
They're each so wonderful. I'm at a loss
as to who
I should follow.
text_block_list.name: Intelligent Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
Oh, everyone's here. Seems like a waste
of time if
you ask me, but...
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Wow, Сэйун Скай is here as well. Not
much is
known of this coy racer, but I'm
excited to learn
more!
text_block_list.name: Sharp-Eared Репортёр

text_block_list.text: Excuse me!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Um, I said excuse me!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Aren't you forgetting someone here? For

instance, the star of this "Golden
Generation" of
yours?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, an Umamusume loudly
announces her
entrance, demanding
everyone's attention.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
How could you forget me, Кинг Хало, a
true
first-rate Umamusume?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
For goodness' sake! How about a round
of
applause? Or at least a "bravo"?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Now is not the time to hold back your
admiration
and praise! Come on, don't
be shy!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
There she is, Кинг Хало, an Umamusume
with a
strong personality who will be
under my
management from now on.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And I mean you too, Trainer! Don't hide
your
adoration! Where's your applause?!
I'm waiting!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
It's Кинг Хало, the daughter of a
legendary
Umamusume with countless
G1 races to her name.
That said...
text_block_list.name: Intelligent Репортёр

text_block_list.text:
Eh... Her mother's a true legend. The
daughter's
bound not to disappoint... I
hope.
text_block_list.name: Sharp-Eared Репортёр

text_block_list.text: Hellooooo?! Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: You know everyone's looking at you, right?

text_block_list.text:
Oh... Are they? Is that why you kept
silent this
entire time?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, there's no need to be so humble.
However,
I can understand if you're
intimidated by my
elegance and the
attention I command.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Uh, King? Everyone's already finished
warming up on
the track.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Let her be, Spe! It's better we start while
Miss Royalty's
got everyone distracted.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! It's finally starting! The Golden

Generation's about to begin their run!
text_block_list.name: Reporters
choice_data_list: You better hurry before they start!

text_block_list.text: What?! But... I haven't even finished half of my self-introduction yet!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Wait, everyone! What are you doing?!
You'd
really dare try to begin without
this year's star?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Whoosh!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Кинг Хало blasts off like a rocket ship.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She bolts away from the spectators, her
speed
pulling their gaze after her as she
cuts toward the
track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Fshhh...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: She really is her daughter!
text_block_list.name: Intelligent Репортёр

text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Wheeze...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I underestimated you! Didn't
think you'd
make it in time.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
I probably would've given up halfway
and gone
fishin' or something.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Hmph. "Give up" is not a phrase I'm
familiar with.
And I certainly wouldn't
walk away from an easy
victory.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Oh?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
When victory is on the line, I'll never
give up!
That is my ethos!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Now, come on, Sky! Let's do another run!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: I'm giving you the right to continue challenging me until I've won!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: What the... Isn't that backwards?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Does my originality perplex
you?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Either way, would you expect anything
less from a
first-rate, multi-talented, and
praiseworthy
Umamusume such as
myself?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
She is extraordinarily different from
others—truly
unique. Her vanity is all
just part of the package.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Our journey to take on the Twinkle
Series
together begins here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
